visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair and glasses, wearing a black puffer vest over a black hoodie, stands in front of a white Lexus SUV with its hood open. He points at the engine components while looking into the camera. The setting is an outdoor street near a storefront. (2) The scene shifts to the man inside the car's driver seat, showcasing the dashboard which displays a mileage of 66366 km. He gestures toward the interior's pristine condition. (3) The man is seen crouching beside the rear tire of the Lexus, using a flashlight and pointing at the tire's manufacturing date code (1939). (4) He opens the rear trunk to demonstrate the cleanliness and large space of the cargo area. (5) The man enters a 'Taoyuan Netcom' retail store where multiple employees in blue uniforms greet him enthusiastically. He presents a gift bag to the store owner. (6) He is shown back in the driver's seat, driving through urban streets while talking to the camera, concluding his review of the car's purchase process.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the successful acquisition of a high-quality second-hand Lexus RX200t from a meticulous owner. It showcases the professional inspection skills of the car dealer, emphasizes the car's 'as-new' condition, and promotes the positive relationship with the previous owner who runs a telecommunications business.
